name: Bat
overview: The Bible references bats in a few key passages, primarily identifying them among unclean creatures in Leviticus 11:19 and Deuteronomy 14:18, where they are listed alongside other birds. Additionally, Isaiah 2:20 uses bats symbolically to illustrate the futility of idolatry, depicting idols being cast to creatures like moles and bats, emphasizing the impotence of man-made gods compared to the living God. These scriptures collectively show bats as part of God's created order, associated with uncleanness in the Mosaic law and as a vivid image of worthless idols in prophetic literature.
